setup: Optimized Rust and unified Chrome WebGPU on stock Zaton, with seeded stock items and surveyed starting positions. A scripted native inventory cursor used the original context menu for all three fits and removals. Reload, Aim, launcher mode and Fire used the original gameplay bindings.

lr300.impact: * Zone detonation: wpn_fake_missile2 particles=explosions\explosion_01 positional_sound=1 light=0 at [397.722,-7.198,202.141]

runNotes: The fixture first used an invalid two-round M209 box. The final fixture used two stock single-round boxes.

The first native inventory run committed the attachments but rendered a bare LR300. Recognizing the CoP WP_* addon classes restored native flags and the fitted scope variant. The old Abakan ghost scope also disappeared after applying the addon bones on rebind.

The next run fired the launcher but the replication view filtered out impact projectiles. The final run drew the M209 and recorded the original impact particles and scheduled positional sound. A separate reload and detach returned the still-loaded grenade.
The incompatible and occupied-slot requests used the same binary WebRTC inventory action directly. The successful fits and detaches used the native menu.
Fitted and fixed scopes have rendered evidence. Adjustable magnification, special vision effects, observer addon models and explosive lighting remain separate gaps.
